adjudication.rationale: In `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`, the Redis key is used as a 60-second throttle, not a lock that must be explicitly released. When `setnx` succeeds, the code immediately sets `expire(retrieved_key, 60)` before returning `false` (allowing `perform_retrieve` to run). If `perform_retrieve` later raises, the key will still expire after 60 seconds, so it is neither “not released” nor “silently dropped” beyond the intended throttle window. The inability to retry within 60 seconds after a failed fetch is consistent with the comment “Throttle other users to once every 60 seconds,” not a clear defect introduced by the diff.
